status.main_product: Geospatial data acquisition, surveying, and drone data mapping services
status.scope_reason: The company provides commercial drone survey, data acquisition, and mapping services to external clients.
status.evidence: According to Ministry of Corporate Affairs records on Tofler, Marvel Geospatial Solutions Private Limited is currently active and headquartered in Hyderabad, India, providing comprehensive drone data acquisition and geospatial solutions.

claims.claim: The company reports operating specific drone platforms such as the SnapM, F90+, and Q6 for national-scale mapping, LiDAR, and aerial surveying projects.

The company utilizes advanced drone systems integrated with specific hardware like the Nextcore Lumos UAV LiDAR system and Kaarta Stencil LiDAR scanners to capture high-density 3D geospatial point clouds.
The company reports that on September 16, 2023, it officially forayed into domestic drone manufacturing to supply locally built UAVs tailored to industry needs.
The company reports that it is a registered drone manufacturer with the Government of India and provides developed, deployment-ready, "Made-in-India" anti-drone passive systems.

The company completed a large-scale project for the National Highways Authority of India (2021–2023) covering 31,316 km across multiple states for drone video recording, 4K timestamped videos, ortho imaging, and asset mapping.

The company reports offering drone data processing and analytics capabilities, extracting forest resource analytics such as canopy height, forest cover, tree girth, and tree count by integrating industry-standard software tools including LAS tools, Terrasolid, ArcGIS MAP, Global Mapper, and custom Python automation scripts.
claims.note: integration of specific software tools (LAS tools, Terrasolid, ArcGIS MAP, Global Mapper, and custom Python automation scripts)

claims.claim: The company reports delivering geospatial data visualization through dedicated client dashboards, data reporting, and real-time Internet of Things (IoT) integrations for its digital twin services.

The company reports delivering drone-based asset monitoring services covering 31,316 kilometers of national highway projects and toll plazas across southern and western Indian zones (including Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh, Goa, Daman & Diu, and Puducherry).

The company reports being empanelled by the National Highways Authority of India (2021–2023) for drone video recording across Zones 3 and 5, covering Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh, Goa, Daman and Diu, and Puducherry.
The company reports participating under the Survey of India's SVAMITVA scheme, actively utilizing drone mapping to validate rural property records within Gujarat and Karnataka.
The company reports in recruitment openings that its Project Manager (Drone Operations) is required to lead and manage a team of 60 to 75 pilots and 30 to 40 drone operations teams across India.
The company reports drone monitoring capabilities spanning 31,316 km across multiple regional zones covering states such as Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh, and Goa.

status.scope_reason: The company provides commercial drone services such as aerial surveying, GIS mapping, and industrial inspections under its own name.
status.evidence: According to the company's website, Akashveer Aerospace provides professional drone survey, mapping, inspection, and agriculture services in India.

claims.claim: The company reports that its custom manufacturing services can build quad, hexa, octo, and fixed-wing frames with integrated payloads like cameras, LiDAR, and spray systems.
The company reports offering "custom drone manufacturing" and specializing in build-to-spec UAV systems.

The company reports having completed a 500-hectare volumetric open-cast mine survey in Bangalore, a 50MW solar farm thermal inspection identifying 347 faulty PV panels in Hyderabad, and weekly drone monitoring of a 45-storey commercial tower construction project over 18 months in Mumbai.

The company reports that its data processing takes 24–48 hours after a typical drone survey to generate deliverables like orthomosaic maps, digital elevation models, 3D point clouds, contour maps, and volume reports.

The company reports that its operations are fully DGCA compliant, including adherence to No Permission No Takeoff (NPNT) protocols, employing DGCA-certified remote pilots on every project, and registering all active drones on the Digital Sky platform.
The company reports delivering an open-cast mine volumetric survey covering 500 hectares of an iron ore mine in Bangalore, utilizing RTK drones to provide weekly stockpile measurements.
The company reports completing a thermal drone inspection across a 50MW solar farm installation in Hyderabad, which successfully identified 347 faulty PV panels within a 2-day period.

The company reports providing nationwide drone operations and aerial coverage across 20+ to 50+ Indian cities, including major hubs like Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Mumbai, Pune, Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon, Jaipur, Ahmedabad, Kolkata, Kochi, Coimbatore, Nagpur, and Bhubaneswar.
